name: Yukinami
source:
"It'll be fun to have you around, so you're coming with me no matter what."

A mysterious young man Yuuki comes across. When he spies something intriguing or beautiful, he rushes to it without second thought.

He always teams up with Hyuuga and tends to order him around, though not intentionally. He lacks common sense and acts immature due to his upbringing.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/paradox/characters/]official website[/url]]
